analysis.reason: 최근 5거래일 누적 -4.1% 하락으로 RSI 35.4 과매도 구간 진입. ADX 21.1로 추세 형성 초기 단계이며, -DI가 +DI보다 우위인 약세 흐름 지속. 현재가 $125.40은 볼린저밴드 하단 $123.78에 근접. 매수 진입은 RSI 30선 회복 및 MACD 히스토그램 개선 확인 후 결정.
analysis.reasonEn: Cumulative -4.1% over the last 5 trading days has pushed RSI to 35.4 in oversold territory. ADX is at 21.1, indicating an early stage of trend formation, with -DI remaining above +DI, suggesting a continued bearish trend. The current price of $125.40 is approaching the lower Bollinger Band at $123.78. Entry for buying will be considered only after RSI recovers above 30 and MACD histogram shows improvement.
